motivation: High batch cosine of a frozen training mean in the first two development pilots motivates an independent cheap closed-loop control; no final tests have run.
definition: Freeze M=sum(G.T@X)/sum(supervised tokens) on predictor_train at the common warmup. At each update use gA=s*B.T@M, gB=s*M@A.T with current factors, same AdamW/clip1 and32steps. Uses no current batch features or online true gradients; it is a local linearization, not current-model full-batch SFT.
selection_rule: Independently select step32 LR by full generation-dev correct count, then CE, then smallerLR, before final freeze.
supplementary_family: 13 planned predictor-minus-train_mean_matrix comparisons. Also report a conservative Holm adjustment over the combined39 planned comparisons; missing comparisons have p=1.
final_inputs: Full official test split; no truncation or final-test-based selection.
